variants.title: Classic
variants.detail: The original dry digital crackle, with uneven short packets and descending reset pulse.

variants.title: Fracture
variants.detail: Ragged forward and backward tearing cuts, widening gaps and unstable read-head motion.

variants.title: Brownout
variants.detail: Darker dirty crackle, sagging low growl and sputtering voltage dropouts.

variants.title: Arc
variants.detail: Bright brief electrical sparks, irregular clustered snaps and short dark spaces.

variants.title: Stutter
variants.detail: A recognizable broken buffer repeats in groups, skips and slows to a stop.
